changelog.body:
Browser Overlay Fix by **RovianDev**.

- Browser scope: Opera, Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Samsung Browser, Firefox, Vivaldi and DuckDuckGo.
- Added an original icon and informational launcher screen.
- Modern LSPosed API 102 registration and explicit callback classes.
- Signed with Rovian.Dev’s release certificate; APK signature, alignment, metadata and compiled classes verified.

**Compatibility:** Tested and working with Panels in Opera, Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Firefox, Vivaldi and DuckDuckGo. Samsung Browser is expected to work but has not been tested. Results can vary with the device and browser version.

**Security tradeoff:** this reduces tapjacking protection for all overlays in selected browsers, not only Panels. It does not grant permissions or change Android’s permission-controller dialogs. Enable only where needed and use trusted overlays.

**Installation:** Install the APK, enable Browser Overlay Fix in LSPosed, select the browsers you need, then force-stop and reopen those browsers or reboot.

[Source and README](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix) · [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/roviandev) · [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/RovianDev)

APK SHA-256: `7cfc77fb47ee93bcdccce24bf4a6f5f24e0c29c3bede85d410bcdb3a2be34349`

readme: # Browser Overlay Fix **An LSPosed API 102 module by [RovianDev](https://github.com/RovianDev).** Makes browser permission dialogs respond when a floating overlay such as Panels causes an “obscured by another app” warning. You still choose **Allow** or **Deny** yourself. ## What it does Inside browsers you select in LSPosed, the module changes Java touch-event reporting so a touch is reported as unobscured. It clears only the obscured and partially obscured flags in `MotionEvent.getFlags()` and returns false from `isObscured()` and, where available, `isPartiallyObscured()`. Browser Overlay Fix v1.0.0 is tested and working with Panels in Opera, Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Firefox, Vivaldi and DuckDuckGo. The module includes a browser allowlist, icon and informational app screen. It does not grant permissions, click buttons, change website permissions, hide installed apps, or modify Panels. It does not hook system_server or Android's permission controller. It has no network permission, analytics, or background service. ## Security tradeoff **This deliberately reduces tapjacking protection throughout each selected browser.** All overlays appear unobscured to these Java checks, not only Panels. A malicious overlay could exploit that reduced protection to mislead you into tapping browser controls. Enable the module only for browsers where you need it, and use trusted overlays. Disable it in LSPosed and restart the browser before sensitive tasks if you want its normal protection restored. The module cannot identify which overlay obscures an individual touch. ## Browser scope and testing | Browser | Package | Status | | --- | --- | --- | | Opera | `com.opera.browser` | Tested and working (v1.0.0) | | Chrome | `com.android.chrome` | Tested and working (v1.0.0) | | Brave | `com.brave.browser` | Tested and working (v1.0.0) | | Microsoft Edge | `com.microsoft.emmx` | Tested and working (v1.0.0) | | Samsung Browser | `com.sec.android.app.sbrowser` | Expected to work; not yet tested | | Firefox | `org.mozilla.firefox` | Tested and working (v1.0.0) | | Vivaldi | `com.vivaldi.browser` | Tested and working (v1.0.0) | | DuckDuckGo | `com.duckduckgo.mobile.android` | Tested and working (v1.0.0) | The seven browsers marked above are tested and working with Panels. Samsung Browser is expected to work because it uses the same Android touch-event APIs, but it has not been tested. Results can vary with the device, browser version, overlay or Android input blocking. Android runtime permission dialogs may still refuse obscured touches. Select only the browsers you need in LSPosed. Package identities were checked against the [official Play listings](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix/blob/main/docs/browser-sources.md). Browser names belong to their respective owners; this project is not affiliated with them. ## Requirements and installation - Rooted Android device running LSPosed with modern API 102 support. - Android 8.0/API 26 or newer is the declared installation minimum; the minimum is not a claim of testing every Android version. - One of the scoped browsers, and an overlay that causes the affected dialog to reject taps. 1. Install the release APK. 2. Enable **Browser Overlay Fix** in LSPosed. 3. Select only the browsers that need the fix. 4. Force-stop those browsers and reopen them, or reboot. 5. Open the affected page and test both Allow and Deny, resetting site permissions between attempts. The launcher screen explains setup and limitations; scope and enablement are managed in LSPosed. It does not display live activation status. ## Source code The complete source and developer build instructions are available in [RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix). ## Testing and troubleshooting See [the test checklist](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix/blob/main/docs/testing.md). In LSPosed logs, search for `BrowserOverlayFix` and `v1.0.0 loaded`, followed by the installed hook count. Three hooks are expected on versions exposing all methods; older Android versions may lack `isPartiallyObscured`. If the module is listed but not working, restart the browser and inspect its logs. A load error means the fix never ran. If hooks install but the warning remains, that browser may use a different detection path. Share the browser version, Android version, LSPosed version and only relevant log lines after removing private data. ## Publishing Source: [RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix). Xposed listing: [io.github.roviandev.browseroverlayfix](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.roviandev.browseroverlayfix). See [publishing instructions](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix/blob/main/docs/publishing.md). Only signed APKs, documentation and public source assets belong in a release. Never upload your development folder wholesale or include signing keys, device logs or unrelated projects. ## Support the developer If Browser Overlay Fix helps you, you can support RovianDev: - [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/roviandev) - [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/RovianDev) Donations are optional; the module remains free and open source. ## License and credits Copyright © 2026 RovianDev. GPL-3.0-only; see [LICENSE](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix/blob/main/LICENSE). Compile-only API stubs were carried forward from existing API 102 module projects. The libxposed API is supplied at runtime by the framework. The globe, overlay and pointer icon is original project artwork, supplied as an editable SVG and Android vector.
readmeZh: # 浏览器覆盖修复 ** [RovianDev](https://github.com/RovianDev) 的 LSPoded API 102 模块。** 当浮动覆盖层（例如面板）导致“被另一个应用程序遮挡”警告时，使浏览器权限对话框做出响应。您仍然可以自己选择**允许**或**拒绝**。 ## 它的作用 在您在 LSPosed 中选择的浏览器内，该模块会更改 Java 触摸事件报告，以便将触摸报告为清晰可见。它仅清除“MotionEvent.getFlags()”中被遮挡和部分遮挡的标志，并从“isObscured()”和“isPartiallyObscured()”（如果可用）返回 false。 浏览器覆盖修复 v1.0.0 已经过测试，可与 Opera、Chrome、Brave、Microsoft Edge、Firefox、Vivaldi 和 DuckDuckGo 中的面板配合使用。该模块包括浏览器白名单、图标和信息应用程序屏幕。 它不会授予权限、单击按钮、更改网站权限、隐藏已安装的应用程序或修改面板。它不挂钩 system_server 或 Android 的权限控制器。它没有网络权限、分析或后台服务。 ## 安全权衡 **这故意减少了每个选定浏览器中的窃听保护。** 所有覆盖层都不会被这些 Java 检查所遮挡，而不仅仅是面板。恶意覆盖可能会利用这种减少的保护来误导您点击浏览器控件。 仅在需要的浏览器中启用该模块，并使用受信任的覆盖层。如果您希望恢复其正常保护，请在 LSPod 中禁用它并在敏感任务之前重新启动浏览器。该模块无法识别哪个覆盖层遮挡了单个触摸。 ## 浏览器范围和测试 |浏览器 |套餐 |状态 | | --- | --- | --- | |歌剧 | `com.opera.browser` |已测试并运行 (v1.0.0) | |铬 | `com.android.chrome` |已测试并运行 (v1.0.0) | |勇敢| `com.brave.browser` |已测试并运行 (v1.0.0) | |微软边缘 | `com.microsoft.emmx` |已测试并运行 (v1.0.0) | |三星浏览器| `com.sec.android.app.sbrowser` |预期工作；尚未测试| |火狐 | `org.mozilla.firefox` |已测试并运行 (v1.0.0) | |维瓦尔第 | `com.vivaldi.browser` |已测试并运行 (v1.0.0) | | DuckDuckGo | `com.duckduckgo.mobile.android` |已测试并运行 (v1.0.0) | 上面标记的七个浏览器已经过测试并且可以与面板一起使用。三星浏览器预计可以运行，因为它使用相同的 Android 触摸事件 API，但尚未经过测试。结果可能因设备、浏览器版本、覆盖或 Android 输入阻止而异。 Android 运行时权限对话框仍可能拒绝遮挡触摸。在 LSPod 中仅选择您需要的浏览器。 已根据[官方 Play 列表](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix/blob/main/docs/browser-sources.md) 检查包身份。浏览器名称属于其各自所有者；该项目与他们无关。 ## 要求和安装 - 运行 LSPod 并支持现代 API 102 的已 Root 的 Android 设备。 - Android 8.0/API 26 或更高版本是声明的最低安装版本；最低限度并不是要求测试每个 Android 版本。 - 范围浏览器之一，以及导致受影响的对话框拒绝点击的覆盖层。 1. 安装发布APK。 2. 在 LSPod 中启用**浏览器覆盖修复**。 3. 仅选择需要修复的浏览器。 4. 强制停止这些浏览器并重新打开它们，或重新启动。 5. 打开受影响的页面并测试“允许”和“拒绝”，在尝试之间重置站点权限。 启动器屏幕解释了设置和限制；范围和支持在 LSPod 中进行管理。它不显示实时激活状态。 ## 源代码 完整的源代码和开发人员构建说明可在 [RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix) 中找到。 ## 测试和故障排除 请参阅[测试清单](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix/blob/main/docs/testing.md）。在 LSPod 日志中，搜索“BrowserOverlayFix”和“v1.0.0 returned”，然后搜索已安装的挂钩计数。公开所有方法的版本预计有 3 个钩子；较旧的 Android 版本可能缺少“isPartiallyObscured”。 如果该模块已列出但无法工作，请重新启动浏览器并检查其日志。加载错误意味着修复从未运行。如果安装了挂钩但警告仍然存在，则该浏览器可能会使用不同的检测路径。分享浏览器版本、Android 版本、LSPod 版本以及删除私人数据后仅相关的日志行。 ## 出版 来源：[RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix)。 Xpose 列表：[io.github.roviandev.browseroverlayfix](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.roviandev.browseroverlayfix)。 请参阅[发布说明](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix/blob/main/docs/publishing.md)。只有签名的 APK、文档和公共源资产才属于发布版本。切勿批量上传您的开发文件夹或包含签名密钥、设备日志或不相关的项目。 ## 支持开发者 如果浏览器覆盖修复对您有帮助，您可以支持 RovianDev： - [请我喝杯咖啡](https://buymeacoffee.com/roviandev) - [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/RovianDev) 捐款是可选的；该模块仍然免费且开源。 ## 许可证和积分 版权所有 © 2026 RovianDev。仅限 GPL-3.0；请参阅[许可证](https://github.com/RovianDev/BrowserOverlayFix/blob/main/LICENSE)。仅编译 API 存根是从现有 API 102 模块项目继承而来的。 libxpose API 由框架在运行时提供。地球仪、覆盖层和指针图标是原始项目图稿，以可编辑的 SVG 和 Android 矢量形式提供。
